{{Top|leg}}
A '''tri-laser engraver''' was a device used in [[Forger (profession)/Legends|counterfeiting]]. It used an array of micro-miniature [[Laser/Legends|laser beams]] to create fine textured incisions onto metals and plastics in order to create facsimiles of planetary [[Currency/Legends|currency]]. [[Opirus Personal Lasers]] manufactured the [[Model KL-543]], and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forger]] [[Magar Jaros]] was known for his skill with it.
